body: It would be great if you can provide plunker or something which demonstrates your issue?

@pkozlowski-opensource This happens because Angular translates `:host:before` to `:before[_nghost-emt-x]`, while the correct order would be `[_nghost-emt-x]:before`. As far as I can tell, this happens with any pseudo-selectors used together with `:host`. See [plunker](http://plnkr.co/edit/89ckPp3XXVKrIEJxdmYB?p=preview).
Probably linked to a change I made recently to have tag selectors appear before the shim attribute selector

**Current behavior**

<!-- Describe how the bug manifests. -->

When Encapsulation is enabled for a component, CSS pseudo class `:host::-webkit-input-placeholder` and perhaps every pseudo class applied to :host is encapsulated incorrectly.

**Expected behavior**

<!-- Describe what the behavior would be without the bug. -->

`:host::-webkit-input-placeholder { ... }` is expected to be compiled into `[_nghost-any-id]::-webkit-input-placeholder { ... }` but instead it's being compiled into `::-webkit-input-placeholder[_nghost-any-id] {...}`

**Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions**

<!--
If the current behavior is a bug or you can illustrate your feature request better with an example, 
please provide the *STEPS TO REPRODUCE* and if possible a *MINIMAL DEMO* of the problem via
https://plnkr.co or similar (you can use this template as a starting point: http://plnkr.co/edit/tpl:AvJOMERrnz94ekVua0u5).
-->

To reproduce create a component with an attribute selector like
`@Component({ selector: '[comp]', encapsulation: ViewEncapsulation.Emulated, ...` and then apply it to an input element like `<input comp type="text" placeholder="Username">` and in the CSS definition for the component have something like `:host::-webkit-input-placeholder { color: red; }` which should turn the placeholder red on Webkit browsers and then check the style generated by Angular for the input element.

**What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior?**

<!-- Describe the motivation or the concrete use case -->

Anywhere that CSS pseudo classes should be applied to the host

issue.title: :host(selector):before doesn't work with standard view encapsulation
issue.body:
**I'm submitting a ...**  (check one with "x")
```
[x] bug report => search github for a similar issue or PR before submitting
[ ] feature request
[ ] support request => Please do not submit support request here, instead see https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#question
```

**Current behavior**

`:host(selector):before` rules are rewritten to `selector:before[_nghost_xyz_1]`, which never matches anything.
Note that `:host:before` without a selector was fixed in #12171 (issue #12165), it is now rewritten to `[_nghost_xyz_1]:before`.

**Expected behavior**

`:host(.foo):before` should match the `:before` of `:host` if it matches `.foo`. [This plunkr](https://plnkr.co/edit/vItv5x9qrKikoj0f2wkN?p=preview) contains a working example in native ShadowDOM.

In this case I'd expect the `:host(selector):before` rule to be rewritten to `selector[_nghost_xyz_1]:before`.

**Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions**

Use any `:host(selector):before` CSS selector. Example found [here](https://plnkr.co/edit/id2szqWRmCOidI0c7q5a?p=preview) (slightly modified the plunkr @krassx posted in #12165)

**What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior?**


**Please tell us about your environment:**

* **Angular version:**

  * next (`npm i @angular/{common,compiler,core,forms,http,platform-browser,platform-browser-dynamic}@next`)


* **Browser:** all
 
* **Language:** all
